title: When You Finally Have Free Time to Play Games
description: No dialogue. Doug drags in after work, drops his bag, sees the console and perks up. He plops on the couch, picks up the controller and boots it up: an original game menu (NEW GAME / CONTINUE / SETTINGS) with quiet music. "15 MINUTES LATER..." He fights sleep: heavy lids, slow blinks, head droops, catches himself, thumb hovering over Start. He falls asleep in a medium close-up, then a sudden wide reveal: asleep, controller still in his hands, NEW GAME still on screen. FAHHH on the cut, a beat, then soft snoring and black.

revisions.text: FULL REVISION V3 (owner brief): 11-12 s cut. Opens seated with the controller, menu on; happy breath + "FINALLY!" with lip-sync; caption POV: GAMING IN YOUR 30s; OTS re-grip, thumb toward the buttons (never presses); hard-cut "3 MINUTES LATER..."; falls asleep in a medium close-up; Vine Boom (supplied vine-boom.mp3) on the wide reveal at 6.8 s instead of FAHHH; snoring from 8.2 s; ends 11.5 s.
